scenarios.name: damper_at_minimum_unfavorable
scenarios.description: Healthy: OAT 28 °C against RAT 22 °C leaves nothing to economize with, and the damper sits at its 20% minimum — the correct response

scenarios.name: damper_above_minimum_unfavorable
scenarios.description: The fault: same unfavorable outdoor condition, damper commanded to 60% — twice the 30% excess threshold; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: favorable_for_economizing
scenarios.description: Econ gate off on its own: OAT 12 °C is 10 °C below return air, so a wide-open damper is free cooling doing its job and no damper position is excessive

scenarios.name: damper_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: damper parked exactly on min_damper_sp × excess_damper_multiplier (20 × 1.5 = 30%) — the strict `>` keeps it out of the alarm

scenarios.name: damper_just_above_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: 30.1% clears the threshold by a tenth of a point and the alarm follows at 1800 s

scenarios.name: deadband_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: rat − oat sits exactly on temp_deadband (22.0 − 21.0 = 1.0 °C) with the damper wide open — the strict `<` leaves the outdoor condition counted as still favorable, so no alarm

scenarios.name: deadband_just_inside_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: rat − oat = 0.9 °C closes the deadband, the outdoor condition counts as unfavorable, and the wide-open damper alarms at 1800 s

scenarios.name: close_temperatures_where_the_ratio_is_blind
scenarios.description: The complementarity case: OAT 23.0 °C against RAT 22.5 °C is a 0.5 °C spread, far inside the 6 °C evaluability gate that puts AHU-0021 and AHU-0030 into NO_EVAL — this rule still reads a 70% damper as excess and alarms at 1800 s

scenarios.name: changeover_arrives_midrun
scenarios.description: Gate edge: the damper is open at 95% throughout, but outdoor air only rises from 12 °C to 28 °C at t=600 — persistence starts from the changeover, not from t=0, so the alarm lands at 2400 s

scenarios.name: damper_closes_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the damper drives from 60% back to its 20% minimum at t=1200, clearing the condition short of alarm_delay, so no alarm

scenarios.name: damper_cycle_resets_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: the damper closes at t=900 and reopens at t=1200 under an unbroken unfavorable outdoor condition — persistence restarts from the reopen, so the alarm lands at 3000 s, not 1800 s
